```mjs title=main.mjs
import { definePropertyGetters, makeNamespaceObject } from "./runtime.mjs";
import * as __rspack_external_fs from "fs";
import { readFileSync } from "fs";

var __commonJS = (factory, flags, id, isEntry, module) => function __require() {
	if (module !== undefined) {
		return module.exports;
	}
	module = { exports: {} };
	if (isEntry) module.isEntry = true;
	if (flags & 1) module.id = id;
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = false;
	if (flags & 4) factory.call(module.exports, module, module.exports, undefined);
	else factory(module, module.exports, undefined);
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = true;
	return module.exports;
};
var require_cjs_consumer = /*#__PURE__*/ __commonJS(function(module, exports) {

/*!**************************!*\
  !*** ./cjs-consumer.cjs ***!
  \**************************/
// CJS module - will NOT be scope-hoisted, causing its fs dep
// to go through init fragment path instead of raw_import_stmts
const fs = external_fs_namespaceObject
exports.g = fs.readFileSync

}, 0, "./cjs-consumer.cjs");

// NAMESPACE OBJECT: external "fs"
var external_fs_namespaceObject = {};
makeNamespaceObject(external_fs_namespaceObject);
definePropertyGetters(external_fs_namespaceObject, {
  readFileSync: () => (readFileSync)
});
var external_fs_namespaceObject_starExports = external_fs_namespaceObject;
Object.keys(external_fs_namespaceObject_starExports).forEach(function(key) {
  if (key !== "default" && key !== "__esModule") {
    definePropertyGetters(external_fs_namespaceObject, { [key]: function() { return external_fs_namespaceObject_starExports[key]; } });
  }
});


// fs?fa25

// ./esm-consumer.js
// ESM module importing fs namespace - will be scope-hoisted (Concatenated)



// fs?94de

// ./cjs-bridge.js
// ESM bridge that re-exports from a CJS module
// This module is ESM but its dependency is CJS, so the CJS module
// and its dependencies (including fs) won't be scope-hoisted


// ./index.js
const cjs_consumer_0 = require_cjs_consumer();



it('should not have duplicate import identifiers from mixed scope-hoisting', () => {
	expect(__rspack_external_fs).toBeDefined()
	expect(cjs_consumer_0.g).toBeDefined()
})

export {};
```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs

// rspack/runtime/define_property_getters
var definePropertyGetters = (exports, getters, values) => {
	var define = (defs, kind) => {
		for(var key in defs) {
			if(hasOwnProperty(defs, key) && !hasOwnProperty(exports, key)) {
				Object.defineProperty(exports, key, { enumerable: true, [kind]: defs[key] });
			}
		}
	};
	define(getters, "get");
	define(values, "value");
};;
export { definePropertyGetters };
// rspack/runtime/has_own_property
var hasOwnProperty = (obj, prop) => (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, prop));
// rspack/runtime/make_namespace_object
// define __esModule on exports
var makeNamespaceObject = (exports) => {
	if(typeof Symbol !== 'undefined' && Symbol.toStringTag) {
		Object.defineProperty(exports, Symbol.toStringTag, { value: 'Module' });
	}
	Object.defineProperty(exports, '__esModule', { value: true });
};;
export { makeNamespaceObject };


```
